result.summary: Fix a descriptor wallet bug where block rescans miss transactions when a transaction paying just outside the look-ahead pool precedes a pool-expanding transaction in the same block. In `ChainScanner::ScanBlock`, the scan now maintains a list of unmatched transaction indices and retries them until a full pass matches no new transactions or all transactions are matched. It also checks for abort and shutdown requests between retry passes.
result.problem: Descriptor wallet rescans (`rescanblockchain`, `importdescriptors`, `restorewallet`) evaluate block transactions strictly in block order. If a transaction paying to an address just beyond the current look-ahead pool appears before a transaction that triggers a pool top-up in the same block, the earlier transaction is ignored; the wallet reports an incorrect balance without warning unless an explicit second rescan is performed.
evidence: Commit message for 54cd292407 provides a reproduction showing that initial block scan misses lookahead transactions and produces an incorrect balance, while a second rescan succeeds.

PR description details gaps found during review in earlier prefix-rescan implementations: multi-level top-up cascades and intra-block spends of look-ahead outputs were missed unless unconfirmed transactions were retried iteratively.
result.scope_notes: The core fix is confined to a compact retry loop in `src/wallet/scan.cpp`, accompanied by comprehensive unit, functional, and benchmark tests.
result.changed_since_previous: Replaced the previous shrinking-prefix rescan approach with a bounded retry-until-stable loop over unmatched transactions, added mid-block abort/shutdown checking, and added a rescan cascade benchmark.
result.card: This pull request fixes a descriptor wallet rescan bug where transactions paying to addresses outside the current look-ahead pool are missed if a pool-expanding transaction appears later in the same block. When this happens during rescans or wallet imports, the wallet displays a lower-than-actual balance with no indication that transactions were skipped. The fix iteratively retries unmatched transactions in the block until no new wallet transactions are detected, ensuring cascading pool expansions and same-block spends of look-ahead outputs are discovered. It also adds a cascade rescan benchmark and allows mid-block aborts during multi-pass rescans.

risk.why: A flaw in wallet block rescanning logic could cause infinite loops, hang wallet imports, or misclassify transaction presence and confirmations.
